spans.s:
लख्, लंख् {c1c} P. (लखति, लंखति) To
go, move.

लंका [लक्-अच् मुम् च]
1 N. of the
capital and residence of Rāvaṇa and
identified with the island of
Ceylon or the chief town in it;
according to some Laṅkā was much
larger than the present island of
Ceylon. It was orginally built for
Mālyavat q. v.
--2 An unchaste
woman, a prostitute, harlot.
--3 A
branch.
--4 A kind of grain.
--Comp.
--अधिपः, --अधिपतिः, --ईशः, --ईश्वरः,
--नथः, --पतिः ‘lord of Laṅkā; i. e.
Rāvaṇa or Bibhīṣaṇa.
--अरिः an
epithet of Rāma.
--दाहिन् m. an
epithet of Hanumat.
लंखनी The bit of a bridle.

लंग् {c1c} P. (लंगति)
1 To go.
--2
To go lame, limp.

1 Lameness.
--2 Union,
association.
--3 A lover, paramour.

लांगलं [लंग् कलच् पृषो˚ वृद्धिः]
1
A plough.
--2 A plough-shaped beam
or timber.
--3 The plam tree.
--4
The membrum virile.
--5 A kind of
flower.
--6 A particular appearance
of the moon.
--7 A kind of timber
(used in building houses).
--Comp.
--ग्रहः a ploughman, peasant.
--दंडः
the pole of a plough.
--ध्वजः N. of
Balarāma.
--पद्धतिः f. a furrow.
--फालः a ploughshare.

लंगूलं The tail of an animal; cf.
लांगूल.

लांगूलं [लंग्-ऊलच् पृषो˚]
1 A tail;
लांगूलचालनमधश्चरणावपातं… श्वा पिंडदस्य
कुरुत

‘wags his tail’.
--2
The membrum virile.
--3 A granary.

लंघ् {c1c} U. (लंघति-ते, लंघित; desid.
लिलंघिषति-ते)
1 To spring, leap, go
by leaps.
--2 To mount upon,
ascend; अन्ये चालंघिषुः शैलान्

.
--4
To fast, abstain from food.
--5 To
dry, dry up (Paras.).
--6 To
diminish, lessen.
--7 To seize upon,
attack, eat up, injure; पल्लवान् हरिणो
लंघितुमागच्छति

. --Caus. or
{c10c} U. (लंघयति-ते)
1 To leap or spring
over, go beyond; सागरः प्लवगेंद्रेण
क्रमेणैकेन लंघितः Mb.;

.
--7 To attack,
seize upon, injure, hurt; एषा खलु
[]
केसरिणी त्वां लंघयति Ś. 7; नास्ति
खलु विधेरलंघनीयं

.
--8 To eat, browse.
--9 To excel,
surpass, outshine, eclipse; (यशः)
जगत्प्रकाशं तदशेषमिज्यया
भवद्गुरुर्लंघयितुं ममोद्यतः

.
--10 To cause
to fast.
--11 To shine.
--12 To
speak.

लंघक^1 a. Ved. A transgressor,
violator, offender &c.
[1] Correction submitted by on 20170110. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/332,. note: from लंघ्.

लंघनं [लंघ्-ल्युट्]
1 Leaping,
jumping.
--2 Going by leaps,
traversing, passing over, going,
motion in general; यूयमेव पथि
शीघ्रलंघनाः Ghaṭ. 8.
--3 Mounting,
ascending, rising up to (fig. also);
नभोलंघन

‘wishing to
attain or aspire to a high position.’
--4 Assaulting, storming, capturing;
as in दुर्गलंघनं.
--5 Exceeding, going
beyond, overstepping, violating,
transgression; आज्ञालंघनं, नियमलंघनं
&c.
--6 Disregarding, despising,
treating with contempt, slighting;
प्रणिपातलंघनं प्रमार्ष्टुकामा

.
--7 An offence, affront, insult.
--8 A harm, an injury; as in
आतपलंघनं q. v.
--9 Fasting, abstinence;
Śi. 12. 25 (where it means
‘leaping’ also).
--10 One of the paces
of a horse.

लंघनीय, लंघ्य a.
1 To be traversed
or passed over, passable.
--2 To be
violated.
--3 To be overtaken;
आत्मोद्धतैरपि रजोभिरलघंनीयाः Ś. 1. 8.
--4
To be neglected or disregarded.
--5
To be fasted; see लंघ्.

लंघनीय, लंघ्य a.
1 To be traversed
or passed over, passable.
--2 To be
violated.
--3 To be overtaken;
आत्मोद्धतैरपि रजोभिरलघंनीयाः Ś. 1. 8.
--4
To be neglected or disregarded.
--5
To be fasted; see लंघ्.

लंघित p. p. [लंघ्-क्त]
1 Lept over,
passed over.
--2 Traversed.
--3
Transgressed, violated.
--4
Disregarded, insulted, disrespected.
--5
Attacked, seized, afflicted; लंघित एष
भूयोऽपि शकुंतलाव्याधिना Ś. 6.

लंज् {vI.v} {c1c} P. (लंजति)
1 To blame,
censure, traduce.
--2 To roast, fry.
{vII.v} {c10c} U. (लंजयति-ते)
1 To injure,
strike, kill.
--2 To give.
--3 To
speak.
--4 To be strong or
powerful.
--5 To dwell.
--6 To shine.
--7 To be manifest.

लाज्, लांज् {c1c} P. (लाजति, लांजति)
1 To blame, censure.
--2 To roast,
fry.

लंजः [लंज्-अच्]
1 A foot.
--2
The end of a lower garment tucked
into the waist-band; cf. कक्षा
--3 A
tail.

1 A current.
--2 An
adulteress.
--3 N. of Lakṣmī.
--4 Sleep.

लंड् {c1c} P., {c10c} U. (लंडति, लंडयति-ते)
1 To toss upwards, throw up.
--2 To
speak.

लंड्रः London(a modern
formation, probably from French Londres).

लंपट a.
1 Greedy, covetous,
hankering after; दधिभक्तलंपट इव

.
--2 Lustful, libidinous,
dissolute, addicted to licentious
pleasures.
--टः A libertine,
profligate, rake; (लंपाक in the same
sense).

लंब् {c1c} A. (लंबते, लंबित)
1 To hang
down, hang from, dangle; ऋषयो ह्यत्र
लंबते Mb.
--2 To be attached to,
stick to, hold on to, rest on;
ललंबिरे सदसिलताः प्रिया इव Śi. 7. 25;
प्रस्थानं ते कथमपि सखे लंबमानस्य भावि

(where लं˚ means ‘hanging,
down towards’ or ‘resting upon’
the back or hips).
--3 To go
down, sink, decline or hang down
(as the sun), fall down; लंबमाने
[]
दिवाकरे; Śi. 9. 20;

(= गलित).
--4 To fall or lag
behind.
--5 To delay, tarry.
--6 To
sound. --Caus. (लंबयति-ते)
1 To
let down, cause to hang down.
--2 To
hang up, suspend.
--3 To stretch
out, extend (as the hand); करेण
वातायनलंबितेन

; को
लंबयेदाहरणाय हस्तं 6. 75.
--4 To cause to
be attached, join.
--5 To depress.
--WITH उद् to stand up, stand
erect: पादेनैकेन गगने द्वितीयेन च भूतले ।
तिष्ठाम्युल्लंबितस्तावद्यावत्तिष्ठति भास्करः

लंब a. [लंब्-अच्]
1 Hanging down,
hanging from, pendent, dangling;
पांड्योयमंसार्पितलंबहारः

.
--2 Hanging upon, attached
to.
--3 Great, large.
--4 Spacious.
--5
Long, tall.
--बः
1 A perpendicular.
--2 Co-latitude, the arc between the
pole of any place and the zenith,
complement of latitude.
--3 A bribe.
--Comp.
--उदर a. big-bellied,
pot-bellied, portly.
--(रः) {1} N. of
Gaṇeśa. {2} a glutton.
--ओष्ठः (
लंबो-बौ-ष्ठः) a camel.
--कर्णः {1} an
ass. {2} a goat. {3} an elephant. {4}
a falcon. {5} a demon or Rākṣasa.
--गुणः, --ज्या, --रेखा the sine of the
co-latitude.
--जठर a. pot-bellied,
portly.
--पयोधरा a woman with
large pendent breasts.
--स्फिच् a.
having fat or protuberant buttocks.

1 An epithet of Durgā.
--2
Of Lakṣmī.

1 A perpendicular (in
geom.).
--2 The complement of
latitude, colatitude (in astr.).

लंबनः [लंब्-ल्यु ल्युट् वा]
1 An
epithet of Śiva.
--2 The phlegmatic
humour.
--नं
1 Hanging down,
depending, descending &c.
--2 Fringe.
--3 The parallax in longitude (of the
moon).
--4 A sort of long necklace.
--5 A mode of fighting.
लंबिका The soft palate or uvula.

लंबित p. p.
1 Hanging down,
pendent.
--2 Suspended.
--3 Sunk, gone
down.
--4 Resting on, attached to
(see लंब्).
लंबुषा A necklace of seven strings.

1 Attainment, acquirement.
--2 Meeting with.
--3 Recovery.
--4
Gain.

लंभित p. p.
1 Procured, got,
obtained.
--2 Given.
--3 Improved.
--4 Employed, applied.
--5
Cherished.
--6 Spoken to, addressed.

लांगलिक a. (की f.) Belonging to
a plough.

लांगलिन् m. [लांगलमस्यास्ति इनि]
1
N. of Balarāma; बंधुपीत्या
समरविमुखो लांगली याः सिषेबे

लांगलीषा (for लांगल-ईषा) The pole
of a plough.
लांगूलिन् m. A monkey, an ape.

लांछ् {c1c} P. (लांछति)
1 To
distinguish, mark, characterize.
--2 To
deck, decorate.

लांछनं [लांछ्-कर्मणि ल्युट्]
1 A sign,
mark, token, characteristic mark;
नवांबुदानीकमुहूर्तलांछने (धनुषि)

; oft. at
the end of comp. in the sense of
‘marked with’, ‘characterized by’
&c.; जातेऽथ देवस्य तया विवाहमहोत्सवे
साहसलांछनस्य

‘bearing the characteristic
epithet श्रीकंठ.’
--2 A name, an
appellation.
--3 A stain, stigma, a
mark of ignominy.
--4 The spot
on the moon;

लांछित p. p. [लांछ्-क्त]
1 Marked,
distinguished, characterised.
--2 Named,
called.
--3 Decorated.
--4 Furnished
with.
